grades.quote: ARM load-exclusive and store-exclusive instructions can likewise map onto their RISC-V LR and SC equivalents, but instead of placing a FENCE RW,RW in front of an LR with _aq_ set, we simply also set _rl_ instead.
grades.reason: Provides useful acquire/release mappings and an aq/rl ordering example, but does not fully define their general memory-ordering guarantees.
